collection.description: Atrahasis, the Babylonian story of the creation of humankind and the Flood, read line by line on photographed clay tablets, with each tablet's own transliteration and B. R. Foster's English translation from the electronic Babylonian Library.

texts.title: Atrahasis, Old Babylonian Tablet I: the rebellion of the gods and the creation of humankind
texts.date_approx: Old Babylonian tablet written by Ipiq-Aya at Sippar, c. 1635 BCE
texts.source: British Museum tablet photographs + eBL manuscript transliterations (eBL corpus edition L I.1, Story of the Flood (Atrahasis) (ed. E. Jiménez and G. Rozzi), OB I) + English of the eBL edition (B. R. Foster (eBL edition))
texts.description: Atrahasis, Old Babylonian Tablet I: 31 of 321 lines, each shown on a photographed cuneiform tablet (1 tablets), with the eBL transliteration of that tablet and B. R. Foster's English translation.
